source.method: Read from GitHub pull request, workflow-run, and file metadata by the Copilot coding agent while preparing PR #220. This is a repository-maintained snapshot, not a live sync.
source.refreshHow: Open each linked pull request on GitHub, compare with this file, edit it in a reviewed pull request, and update recordedAt and observedAt. See docs/FOUNDER_REVIEW_COMMAND_CENTER.md.

nextStep.title: Let the tests run on PR #216 — nothing else is needed today.
nextStep.why: PR #216 is the foundation that #217 builds on. Its tests have not run on the current commit because GitHub is waiting for approval, so nobody can yet see whether it works.
nextStep.how: Open the linked run, press "Approve and run" (or re-run), and wait for the result. Reviewing and merging are separate, later steps.

basics: Tests passing means the code checks passed. It does not mean you have accepted the work.
A pull request is a proposal. Nothing in it is on the main branch or in production until you merge it and it is deployed.
One pull request at a time is enough. Everything else below can wait.

needsFounderDecision.title: Merge order for the overlapping pull requests
needsFounderDecision.provenance: Proposed by the Copilot coding agent from the files each pull request changes.
needsFounderDecision.question: #216 and #217 change the same accountability file; #216 and #219 change the same workflow spot. Which should go first?
options: #216 first, then rebase #217, then #219 (suggested: #216 is the foundation).
Pause all three; nothing merges until you choose.
needsFounderDecision.ifNoDecision: Nothing merges. All three stay open and unchanged.
needsFounderDecision.nextStep: Choose when you review #216; no rush before its tests have run.

needsFounderDecision.title: How the #216 PR-body rule treats pull requests that are already open
needsFounderDecision.provenance: Proposed by the Copilot coding agent. #216's own description lists historical and administrative exception paths; that code is not on the base branch.
needsFounderDecision.question: If #216 merges, should its required Task-ID/accountability sections fail older open pull requests?
options: Apply only to pull requests opened after #216 merges; older ones use the historical exception.
Run it as advisory (non-failing) for two weeks, then make it required.
Require it immediately for every open pull request.
needsFounderDecision.ifNoDecision: No new required PR-body rule exists on the base branch; this pull request does not add one.

needsFounderDecision.title: Required checks and founder review before merge
needsFounderDecision.provenance: GitHub reports these pull requests as "blocked", and PROJECT_TIMELINE.md records CI-gated auto-merge as live. Repository settings cannot be read or changed from code, so the exact rules are unverified here.
needsFounderDecision.question: Should merges into axaxiaxes-axiom-monorepo require passing checks and your approving review, and should auto-merge stay enabled?
options: Require checks and one founder approval; keep auto-merge only after both.
Leave settings as they are for now.
needsFounderDecision.ifNoDecision: Settings stay exactly as they are; nothing in this repository changes them.
needsFounderDecision.nextStep: If you want the gate, follow the manual steps in docs/FOUNDER_REVIEW_COMMAND_CENTER.md.
